_comment: Exportable Directus Flow definition for VAMO Business Portal — Phase 2: Read-Only Stripe Upgrade Invoice Preview. Target: Quepasa (https://quepasa-api.c1oud7.de). Do not deploy without explicit authorization.

flows.name: Stripe - Preview Subscription Plan Change
flows.description: Read-only supporting Flow that verifies authenticated customer/subscription ownership and calls POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/create_preview to calculate the authoritative Stripe proration preview for an immediate subscription upgrade without mutating the subscription or creating a collectible invoice.

operations.name: Validate Authenticated User & Target Price Input
Get Stripe Customer by Server-Side Email
Verify Ownership, Validate Upgrade Price & Build Preview Request
